Custom Layered Shades Fort Wayne Indiana

Alternating sheer and solid bands let you change the light without lifting the entire shade. See how layered, or zebra, shades work during an in-home consultation.

Serving Fort Wayne, Allen County & Northeast Indiana

Options & materialsFitting & installationCareQuestions

Two fabric layers, adjustable bands

Layered shades move two layers of striped fabric past one another. Aligning the sheer bands admits more light; moving the solid bands across them increases coverage. We show Fort Wayne homeowners how the bands look in different positions so the choice is based on everyday use as well as the pattern.

Sheer and solid fabrics

Compare the transparency of the sheer bands and the opacity of the solid ones. Closed bands do not make every layered shade a blackout treatment. If the window faces a street, discuss nighttime privacy for the specific fabric.

Band size and alignment

The repeated horizontal pattern is a visible part of this style. On several adjacent windows, discuss mounting height and band alignment before ordering. Window dimensions and shade position can affect the way the bands line up.

Manual or motorized adjustment

Small movements change the band alignment. Try the available controls and think about how often you adjust the shade. Motorized operation needs confirmation for the selected product, size, and control system.

Measured and installed for you

Layered shades installation in Fort Wayne

We measure the recess and check the depth required for the headrail and two fabric layers. Handles and trim need clearance. For side-by-side windows, we plan the mounting positions together and explain any limitations in matching the bands.

Before you choose

Layered shades have a more visible pattern than a plain roller fabric. If you want an uninterrupted fabric surface, compare roller shades. If your priority is a darker bedroom, compare the selected layered fabric with cellular or roller room-darkening options.

From samples to installation

David brings samples to your home and measures the opening. Once you have chosen the material and controls, we confirm the quote and expected timing. We return to install the treatment, check its operation, and show you how to use it.

Compare all shades

Caring for your layered shades

Treat the sheer bands gently. Follow the fabric’s cleaning instructions and avoid scrubbing or soaking the layers. If the bands stop aligning correctly or the shade rolls unevenly, ask about service rather than pulling the fabric into position.

Questions about layered shades

Talk through your windows, the room, and the options before ordering.

Call David at (260) 222-6467
Are zebra shades and layered shades different?

The names are commonly used for the same alternating-band style. We keep them together here so you can compare fabric and control options in one place.

Can I use layered shades in a bedroom?

It depends on the selected fabric and how much darkness you need. Solid bands improve coverage but do not guarantee a dark room. Discuss nighttime privacy and light gaps before choosing.

Will bands match across neighboring windows?

We plan the mounting and check the product’s alignment limitations. Different window sizes and shade positions can affect the result, so this should be discussed before the order is placed.
